arxiv-2110-06119.title: The Turing machine of a harmonic oscillator: from the code to the dynamic system
arxiv-2110-06119.creator: Francesco Sisini, Valentina Sisini
arxiv-2110-06119.description: Abstract Abstract In this work we consider a dynamic system consisting of a damped harmonic oscillator and we formalize a Turing Machine whose definition in terms of states, alphabet and transition rules, can be considered equivalent to that of the oscillator.

arxiv-2212-13307.title: Fabrication Sequence Optimization for Minimizing Distortion in Multi-Axis Additive Manufacturing
arxiv-2212-13307.creator: Weiming Wang, Fred van Keulen, Jun Wu
arxiv-2212-13307.description: Abstract Additive manufacturing of metal parts involves phase transformations and high temperature gradients which lead to uneven thermal expansion and contraction, and, consequently, distortion of the fabricated components. The distortion has a great influence on the structural performance and dimensional accuracy, e.g., for assembly. It is therefore of critical importance to model, predict and, ultimately, reduce distortion.

arxiv-2305-13755.title: Topic-driven Distant Supervision Framework for Macro-level Discourse Parsing
arxiv-2305-13755.creator: Feng Jiang, Longwang He, Peifeng Li, Qiaoming Zhu, Haizhou Li
arxiv-2305-13755.description: Abstract Discourse parsing, the task of analyzing the internal rhetorical structure of texts, is a challenging problem in natural language processing. Despite the recent advances in neural models, the lack of large-scale, high-quality corpora for training remains a major obstacle. Recent studies have attempted to overcome this limitation by using distant supervision, which utilizes results from other NLP tasks (e.g.

arxiv-2311-17828.title: Dynamic redundancy as a mechanism to optimize collective random searches
arxiv-2311-17828.creator: Daniel Campos and Vicenç Méndez
arxiv-2311-17828.description: Abstract We explore the case of a group of random walkers looking for a target randomly located in space, such that the number of walkers is not constant but new ones can join the search, or those that are active can abandon it, with constant rates r b r_{b} and r d r_{d} , respectively.

arxiv-2501-12912.title: Quantification of Ultrafast Nonlinear Photothermal and Photoacoustic Effects in Molecular Thin Films via Time-Domain Brillouin Scattering
arxiv-2501-12912.creator: Valentin Cherruault, Franck Camerel, Julien Morin, Amédée Triadon, Nicolas Godin, Ronan Lefort, Olivier Mongin, Jean-François Bergamini, Antoine Vacher, Mark G. Humphrey, Maciej Lorenc, Frederic Paul, Thomas Pezeril
arxiv-2501-12912.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Valentin Cherruault, Franck Camerel, Julien Morin, Amédée Triadon, Nicolas Godin, Ronan Lefort, Olivier Mongin, Jean-François Bergamini, Antoine Vacher, Mark G. Humphrey, Maciej Lorenc, Frederic Paul, Thomas Pezeril. Improving the efficiency of photothermal (PT) therapies and photoacoustic (PA) imaging at the microscopic scale hinges on developing multiphoton-absorbing photothermal molecules or contrast agents that operate in the near-infrared (NIR) range.

arxiv-2502-02147.title: On Siegel’s problem and Dwork’s conjecture for G G -functions
arxiv-2502-02147.creator: Javier Fresán, Yeuk Hay Joshua Lam, Yichen Qin
arxiv-2502-02147.description: Abstract . We answer in the negative Siegel’s problem for G G -functions, as formulated by Fischler and Rivoal. Roughly, we prove that there are G G -functions that cannot be written as polynomial expressions in algebraic pullbacks of hypergeometric functions; our examples satisfy differential equations of order two, which is the smallest possible.

arxiv-2511-10470.title: From Local Nonclassicality to Entanglement: A Convexity Law for Single-Excitation Dynamics
arxiv-2511-10470.creator: Atta ur Rahman, Ao-xiang Liu, M. Y. Abd-Rabbou, Cong-Feng Qiao
arxiv-2511-10470.description: Abstract We prove a simple dynamical law for excitation-preserving interactions: the sum of local Wigner negativities is upper-bounded by a fixed budget set by the initially excited state. For the single-excitation sector of the XY model (and its beam-splitter analogue), this convexity bound equals the negativity of the seed state and is saturated only when the excitation is fully localized.

arxiv-2511-12942.title: The doubling property of the elliptic measure, for elliptic operators with drifts satisfying an average diverging condition.
arxiv-2511-12942.creator: Aritro Pathak
arxiv-2511-12942.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Aritro Pathak. We show doubling of the elliptic measure corresponding to the operator with an elliptic principal term and a drift that diverges, on average on Whitney cubes, like the inverse distance to the boundary, with a small constant. Essentially a small Carleson constant assumption on the drift, this generalizes earlier results with the hypothesis of pointwise smallness of such a drift.

arxiv-2604-13751.title: Probing the real-space density of spin-entangled electrons
arxiv-2604-13751.creator: Federico Pisani, Leonie Spitz, Libor Vojáček, Flaviano José dos Santos, Alberto Carta, Bastien Dalla Piazza, Stanislav E. Nikitin, Karl W. Krämer, Björn Fåk, Taro Nakajima, Daichi Ueta, Hiraku Saito, Jian-Rui Soh, Nicola Marzari, Henrik M. Rønnow

govdocs-archive_org-nsia-Sources_Sources.creator: Federal Bureau of Investigation (Anton Pavrlka Jr.)
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-Sources_Sources.description: FBI Dallas report (DL 89-43) on the November 1963 effort to locate a federal statute covering the assassination of President Kennedy, and on investigations of past threats against the late President.

pmc-10675319.title: Hierarchical Nickel Cobalt Phosphide @ Carbon Nanofibers Composite Microspheres: Ultrahigh Energy Densities of Electrodes for Supercapacitors
pmc-10675319.creator: Jinqiao Zhang, Meiling Cen, Tao Wei, Qianyun Wang, Jing Xu, Diego Cazorla-Amorós
pmc-10675319.description: Supercapacitors (SCs) are widely used in energy storage devices due to their superior power density and long cycle lifetime. However, the limited energy densities of SCs hinder their industrial application to a great extent. In this study, we present a new combination of metallic phosphide–carbon composites, synthesized by directly carbonizing (Ni1−xCox)5TiO7 nanowires via thermal chemical vapor deposition (TCVD) technology.

pmc-11344304.title: Coagulation dysfunction events associated with echinocandins: a real-world study from FDA adverse event reporting system (FAERS) database
pmc-11344304.creator: Qian Cheng, Ye Wu, Zeyu Yao, Mengling Ouyang, Shupeng Zou, Xuan Shi, Yazheng Zhao, Minghui Sun
pmc-11344304.description: BackgroundEchinocandins belong to the fourth generation of antifungals, and there are no systematic studies on their risk in coagulation dysfunction; this study will predict the risk of coagulation dysfunction of echinocandins using the US Food and Drug Administration Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) database.MethodData from January 2004 to March 2024 were obtained from FAERS.

pmc-11465128.title: Behavioral and neural correlates of diverse conditioned fear responses in male and female rats
pmc-11465128.creator: Julia R. Mitchell, Lindsay Vincelette, Samantha Tuberman, Vivika Sheppard, Emmett Bergeron, Roberto Calitri, Rose Clark, Caitlyn Cody, Akshara Kannan, Jack Keith, Abigail Parakoyi, MaryClare Pikus, Victoria Vance, Leena Ziane, Heather Brenhouse, Mikaela A. Laine, Rebecca M. Shansky
pmc-11465128.description: Pavlovian fear conditioning is a widely used tool that models associative learning in rodents. For decades the field has used predominantly male rodents and focused on a sole conditioned fear response: freezing. However, recent work from our lab and others has identified darting as a female-biased conditioned response, characterized by an escape-like movement across a fear conditioning chamber.

pmc-11685010.title: An eco-psychological framework for research on the physical environment of childcare classrooms and children’s play behavior
pmc-11685010.creator: Chenhao Deng, Zhiyi Zhao, Nur maizura Ahmad Noorhani, Arniatul Aiza Mustapha
pmc-11685010.description: Ecological psychology is an approach focused on the perception and behavior of organisms and environments, offering psychological insights for research on children. This study primarily explored the concepts of affordance and behavior setting based on an eco-psychological perspective concerning children’s behaviors and environment.

pmc-12553712.title: Body composition measurement and diabetes – A new perspective on development of antibodies after SARS-CoV-2 booster vaccination
pmc-12553712.creator: Lukas Van Baal, Susanne Tan, Dagmar Fuhrer, Johanna Reinold, Ulf Dittmer, Melanie Fiedler
pmc-12553712.description: PurposeIn patients with SARS-CoV-2 infection overweight and diabetes are associated with poor prognosis. Therefore, effectiveness and tolerance of booster vaccination against SARS-CoV-2 has to be ensured. We examined the impact of overweight and diabetes on anti-SARS-CoV-2-titers and the incidence of side effects after booster vaccination.

pmc-12636217.title: Optimal cutoff score for the Malay version of parenting and child tooth brushing assessment (M-PACTA)
pmc-12636217.creator: Yu Jie Chin, Jennifer Geraldine Doss, Sabri Musa, Danaee Mahmoud, Shani Ann Mani
pmc-12636217.description: BackgroundRoutine effective tooth brushing with fluoridated toothpaste has a substantial impact on preventing dental caries. Parent and child roles in establishing routine tooth brushing habits in preschool children encounter numerous challenges. The Malay version of the Parenting and Child Tooth Brushing Assessment (M-PACTA) is a comprehensive tool with four scales that assesses various aspects of parent-child behaviour during tooth brushing.

pmc-12730036.title: Assessment of the Awareness and Use of Quality of Life Tools in Small Animal Practices in Germany
pmc-12730036.creator: Friederike Felicitas Rhein, Rebecca Klee, Balazs Albrecht, Stephanie Krämer, Laura A Reese
pmc-12730036.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryQuality of life (QoL) plays an important role in veterinary medicine. Over the last decades, different tools have been developed to assess the QoL of an animal in a more structured way. While there is a lot of research on how to develop and improve such tools, there is little knowledge about whether and to what extent those tools are used in veterinary practice.

pmc-12975503.title: Recent Advances in Understanding Bio-Compounds from Haloarchaea
pmc-12975503.creator: Chi Young Hwang, Myung-Ji Seo
pmc-12975503.description: Haloarchaea are extreme halophilic microorganisms that thrive in hypersaline environments. They possess unique physiological, metabolic, and molecular adaptations that enable robust biomanufacturing under harsh conditions. Growing taxonomic diversity, advances in genome sequencing, and the development of genetic and process engineering tools have significantly expanded interest in haloarchaea as non-conventional microbial cell factories.

pmc-13051244.title: Role of Posterior Tibial Slope Osteotomy in Revision Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Narrative Review
pmc-13051244.creator: Javier Gonzalez Almonacid
pmc-13051244.description: Failure after anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction remains a significant clinical challenge, particularly in the revision setting. Among biomechanical factors, increased posterior tibial slope (PTS) is an important factor to consider during the preoperative evaluation of patients undergoing revision ACL reconstruction.

pmc-13199870.title: Experimental Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Prolongs Post-Incisional Mechanical Hypersensitivity and Increases Cutaneous Neuro-Immune Markers in Adult Female Offspring
pmc-13199870.creator: Carlos A Cantú-Cepeda, Jaira Villarreal-Salcido, Cecilia Esther Elizondo-Martinez, Juan Antonio Vazquez-Mora, Arisai Martínez-Martínez, Rosa Issel Acosta-González, Juan Miguel Jiménez-Andrade, Enriqueta Muñoz-Islas
pmc-13199870.description: PurposeGestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) can lead to health complications in adult offspring. It was recently reported that experimental GDM increases intraepidermal nerve fiber density (INFD) in adult mouse offspring. However, the impact of GDM on acute postsurgical pain and the neuroimmune response to incision has not been examined.

pmc-13291732.title: Clinical Effects of a Digital Health Intervention for Adults With Type 2 Diabetes in the United States: Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13291732.creator: David Kerr, Nita Thingalaya, Praveen Potukuchi, Keni CS Lee, Edward Jonathan Han-Burgess, Darren Frey, Alison Edwards, Xinyan Yu, Laura Wilson, Felix Lee
pmc-13291732.description: BackgroundDigital health interventions show promise in supporting adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Dario is a digital diabetes solution (DDS) that allows individuals with T2DM to automatically log blood glucose (BG) measurements and other variables to facilitate positive behavior changes.

pmc-13302461.title: Innovations in Advanced Endoscopic Resection of Early Upper Gastrointestinal Cancer
pmc-13302461.creator: Andrea Sorge, Pieter Jan Poortmans, Michele Montori, Maria Eva Argenziano, Edoardo Vincenzo Savarino, David J. Tate
pmc-13302461.description: Endoscopic resection (ER) has become the preferred curative-intent treatment for early upper gastrointestinal cancer, given its superior safety profile compared to surgery. Over the past decade, technological and procedural innovation has substantially expanded the scope, safety, and precision of endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) and related techniques. This review synthesises current evidence on key advances relevant to upper gastrointestinal ESD practice.

pmc-13305213.title: Impact of varying degree of donor-recipient weight mismatch on survival outcomes in pediatric heart transplantation
pmc-13305213.creator: Rohit Ganduboina, John Karamichalis, Xander Jacquemyn, Michel Pompeu Sá, Leonardo Mulinari, Sandeep Sainathan
pmc-13305213.description: ObjectivesBody weight is still the most common metric used for donor-recipient matching in Pediatric Heart Transplantation (PHTX) and its impact on long-term outcomes remains unclear from variable definition and conflicting evidence. In this study, the outcomes of varying weight mismatch on PHTX was analysed.MethodsThe United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) database (1984–2025) was retrospectively analysed.

pmc-13400246.title: Pathway-driven therapeutic stratification in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
pmc-13400246.creator: Eduardo Chuluyan, Daniel Grasso, Analia Pasqua, Carla Remolins, Andrea Paes de Lima, Kevin Matamoros, Diego Guerrieri, Gustavo Kohan, Florencia Gottardo, Martin Ledesma, Juan Garona, Carlos Davio, Agustin Yaneff, Maria Noe Garcia, Daniela Papademetrio, Maria Eugenia Pasqualini, Luis Sarotto, Jonatha
pmc-13400246.description: Highlights•PDAC progression reflects stage-specific pathway rewiring rather than uniform disease escalation.•Resectable PDAC is defined by MAPK-driven proliferation, glycolytic metabolism, and partial immune competence.•Borderline/locally advanced PDAC represents a transitional state with emerging PI3K-AKT-mTOR activation and metabolic plasticity.•Metastatic PDAC converges toward mitochondrial metabolism, redox adaptation, proteostasis support, and immune evasion.

pmc-13441559.title: Real-World Performance of Non-Allergist-Led Penicillin Allergy Delabeling: Prospective Head-to-Head Comparison of APAAACI vs. PENFAST
pmc-13441559.creator: Freya KL Chung, Weihong Shi, Man Yui Chong, Elaine Lee, Jackie SH Yim, Valerie Chiang, Philip H Li
pmc-13441559.description: PurposeAlthough around 90% of penicillin allergies are mislabelled, delabeling initiatives have been hindered by limited access to drug allergy services. Asia Pacific Association of Allergy, Asthma, and Clinical Immunology (APAAACI) and PENFAST risk-stratification tools can facilitate non-allergist delabeling, but their comparative real-world performance remains unknown.
